system.description:
You gather your Tao within yourself, before moving fast enough to leave afterimages of yourself, while attempting to strike simultaneously with your afterimage, against all creatures in range. Select a point you can see within 60 feet. Make a single melee taijutsu attack, comparing the result vs the AC of all creatures of your choice within the affected area.

On a hit, you deal [Weapon Damage] + 3d10 and the affected creatures make a Constitution saving throw, becoming Staggered and Severed on a failure.

Ideal Cut: One creature within range, makes their saving throw at disadvantage.

Tao: This attack has a +2 bonus to its critical threat range. If this attack scores a critical hit, you also gain the effect of your Empty Blade attack as if you were forgoing 2 attacks, against all creatures within range.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above B-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3, the damage by 1d10.
